```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>"
)
```

```{r setup}
library(WondeCL)
```

*This article explains how to perform sanity checks on a class list and make manual changes to it.*

First lets load an example class list

```{r}
class_list = WondeCL::class_list_example

class_list |> DT::datatable(options = list(pageLength = 5))

```

By manually looking at the class list we see that there are:

- 2 Schools
- 3 classes
- 60 students

# Class list checks

Firstly, we will perform some class list checks for whether students belong to multiple classes or no classes at all.

```{r}
class_list |> WondeCL::detect_multiple_class_memberships()

class_list |> WondeCL::detect_students_missing_class()

WondeCL::clean_class_names()
```
